TableRow.variants: Header = Yes | No; Narrow first = No | Yes

howTo: Page: await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('8253:5009')). Write only inside your section's Content frame (sections.NN.contentId); the Content column is vertical auto-layout, gap 32, width 1024.

Instance: const inst = (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(kit.X)).createInstance(); parent.appendChild(inst); THEN inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = 'FILL' (Canvas, Table row, Metric card / DoDont / Tile inside a horizontal row). For variants use the variant component id directly (e.g. kit.DoDont.Dont) or inst.setProperties({Kind:'Dont'}).

Text props: inst.setProperties({'Text#24009:2':'Size=lg'}) (Caption), {'Text#24009:3':'…'} (Subheading), {'Label#24009:6':'B'} (Marker), {'Number#24009:7':'3','Label#24009:8':'размера'} (Metric card), {'Rule#24009:14':'…'} (DoDont), {'Cell 1#24009:26':'…', …, 'Cell 5#24009:30':'…', 'Marker#24009:31':true} (Table row). No font loading needed for setProperties.

Slots (Canvas/Tile = 'Content', DoDont = 'Example'): const slot = inst.children.find(n => n.type==='SLOT' && n.name==='Content'); slot.appendChild(node). Use direct children, not findOne (finds nested slots). Slot itemSpacing/padding can be overridden; slot layoutMode can NOT (stays VERTICAL) — for a row, append a horizontal auto-layout frame (fills=[], clipsContent=false) into the slot and FILL it.

Guide/Canvas = grey panel (bg/neutral/primary, r24, p48); Guide/Tile = white example tile (r16, p32, centered); Guide/Caption goes ABOVE the example (put Caption + example in a vertical auto-layout cell, gap 12).
Коротко: Canvas → horizontal row frame in slot → 4× Metric card, each layoutSizingHorizontal='FILL'.
Делаем / не делаем: Canvas (or plain row) → horizontal row gap 32 → DoDont Do + DoDont Dont, each FILL; put the example into the 'Example' slot; Rule ≤ 8 words.

Table: vertical auto-layout frame (gap 0, fills=[]) → 1× Table row Header=Yes + N× Header=No, each FILL. Hide unused columns: inst.children.find(n=>n.name==='Cell 5').visible=false (do it for header and body rows alike). Narrow first=Yes gives a fixed 48 first column for № / marker (Анатомия, Спецификация). In body rows with 'Marker#24009:31'=true, set marker text via the nested instance: cell1.children.find(n=>n.name==='Marker').setProperties({'Label#24009:6':'A'}) and hide 'Text 1' (visible=false). Cell widths cannot be overridden on instances — other column grid → detachInstance().

Marker: Type=Number (anatomy 1,2,3) / Type=Letter (spec A,B,C). Place ON the element: inside a non-auto-layout stage frame, or inst.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE' inside auto-layout, then set x/y so the marker center sits on the element edge/corner.

Overlay: Kind=Padding (bg/critical/secondary-light) / Kind=Gap (bg/brand/secondary-light). Put over the example: inst.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE' (if parent is auto-layout), inst.resize(w,h), x/y = measured area.

Section aside: description text is hidden and empty — to use: load Inter Regular, set characters, visible=true. Skipped section → (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(sections.NN.frameId)).remove(). Section 01 lives inside the cover wrapper (coverWrapperId) right under the Cover.

Cover preview: coverPreviewSlotId is a plain auto-layout frame (HORIZONTAL, gap 16, right-aligned, fixed 600×124) inside the glass 'Container'; append Badge instances at 1× (no scaling); can switch it to HUG if needed.
Kit components live in frame 'Guide kit' (kitFrameId); Tile, Metric card and DoDont sit on a grey preview panel inside it. Do not move or edit kit components; instance them.
